run_RAFT_demo: run the RAFT optical flow demo on a directory of images to compute and visualize flow
run_RAFT_infer: run RAFT_infer to load a pretrained RAFT model and return it for inference
run_load_image_list: run load_image_list to load and pad a sorted list of image files into a CUDA tensor
run_load_image: run load_image to load a single image file and convert it to a PyTorch tensor
run_viz: run viz to visualize optical flow by converting it to an RGB image and saving to disk
